scope: Normal Microsoft Edge on previously prepared KartaView photos. The four-second 48 kHz local source was uploaded as an original WAV and played through a browser test microphone with the same mono PCM duplicated into a stereo stream. Whisper ran on CPU. The engineering test did not recruit a passenger. No raw audio, session tokens or camera coordinates are in this record.

additional_configuration.outcome: A separate stage launched without the public prepared-photo flags fell through to the local model on the first free-form request and timed out. The documented timing below was retained separately from the normal configured site.

mobile_observation: At 390 by 844 pixels the main microphone button was visible, the upload was in Voice options and the page fit horizontally. During initial transcript review both Discard recording and Cancel request were offered. Only the first restored the prior typed words; the similar purposes could be clearer to a new passenger.
